A1.justification: Both PDFs describe DioR. Their main text, equations, figures, tables and appendices are readable and support comparison, including matching material across relocations.

before.justification: V1 reports original QA experiments, component ablations, efficiency measurements, case studies and hallucination-detector results in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: V2 retains the original experimental results, including Tables 1–8 and the detector analyses in Appendix C.6.

M1.justification: The RNN early detector, MLP real-time detector, retrieval triggers, keyword ranking and post-retrieval procedures are unchanged. Algorithms 1–2 and the appendix pseudocode retain the same procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions use Wikipedia for detector construction and evaluate the same seven QA datasets. NaturalQuestions, TriviaQA and SQuAD receive new descriptions in v2, but their experiments already appear in v1 Appendix C.2 and Table 5.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Tables 2, 5 and 6 and the detector comparison in Appendix C.6. Deleted Table 9 was a conceptual comparison with detection-and-regeneration, not an evaluated experimental baseline.

E3.justification: V2 omits the separate Jensen–Shannon-distance diagnostic for comparing dataset distributions in v1 Appendix B.1, removing that reported evaluation procedure. The retained experiments preserve their splits, model sizes, metrics and generation/retrieval budgets.

E4.justification: The six-pair dataset-distribution analysis in Appendix B.1 is removed. Component ablations, efficiency analyses, case studies and hallucination-detector analyses remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests. The retained distribution plots do not introduce any change in uncertainty-reporting practice.

E6.justification: V2 removes six Jensen–Shannon distance results, including 0.5804 for 2WikiMultihopQA versus IIRC and 0.5721 for 2WikiMultihopQA versus HotpotQA. Tables 1–8, the plotted findings and the detector AUC comparison retain their results.

T1.justification: The retrieval-trigger definitions, classifier equations and attribution-entropy derivation in Appendix A.1.1 are unchanged. No mathematical assumptions, proofs or formal properties are added or removed.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions and conclusion retain the same claims about adaptive retrieval timing, contextual retrieval optimization and superior performance. The expanded dataset documentation does not redefine the core contribution.

C2.justification: V2 removes the conclusion that the dataset pairs exhibit strong distribution differences and deletes Table 9's qualitative advantages over detection-and-regeneration, including its exponential-cost assertion. The main result interpretations and limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Appendix B adds descriptions of previously evaluated single-hop datasets, including SQuAD 2.0's answerability format, and characterizes Qwen2.5-7B as a dialogue-oriented fine-tuned backbone. These expand documentation without establishing changed experiments; hardware, hyperparameters, sample counts and prompts are retained.

R1.justification: V2 adds references for NaturalQuestions, TriviaQA, SQuAD 2.0 and Qwen2.5. The related-work discussion and positioning against existing dynamic RAG methods otherwise remain unchanged.

P1.justification: V2 expands Appendix B, shortens the dynamic-RAG explanation, moves the ablation prompt from C.7 to Appendix F, and revises author and acknowledgment information. Most prose and the overall narrative structure are retained.

P2.justification: V2 enlarges Figure 2, expands figure captions, moves table captions above their tables, and reformats Table 5 with grouped dataset headings in one column. Table 9 is removed; all nine figures are retained with some repositioning.

improvement.justification: V2 modestly improves documentation by describing and citing benchmarks and a backbone already used in v1, and makes Table 5 easier to read. Removing Table 9 also removes an unsupported exponential-cost assertion. The loss of six dataset-distance results reduces supplementary characterization, but the central experimental evidence is preserved. These are limited improvements, without new validation or methodological advances.
